description: An expander for MEGA-TANG, sitting immediately to its right: it adds a levelled mono input, two more mono inputs and a stereo pair to that module's mix, and three more sends

params.text: Sets how much of the Line In signal reaches MEGA-TANG's send, taken before the level control; it comes up at nothing
Sets the level of the Line In signal into MEGA-TANG's mix, from silence to unity; it comes up at silence
Sets how much of the In 5 signal reaches MEGA-TANG's send; it comes up at nothing
Sets how much of the In 6 signal reaches MEGA-TANG's send; it comes up at nothing

inputs.text: A mono signal added to both sides of MEGA-TANG's mix at the level set here, and separately to its send
A mono signal added to both sides of MEGA-TANG's mix at full level; it has no level control, only a send
A mono signal added to both sides of MEGA-TANG's mix at full level; it has no level control, only a send
The left side of a stereo pair added to MEGA-TANG's left mix output at full level
The right side of a stereo pair added to MEGA-TANG's right mix output at full level; with nothing patched it takes the left side of the pair

notes: nothing here does anything unless MEGA-TANG is the module immediately to the left. There are no output jacks: everything arrives in MEGA-TANG's mix and send.
all four knobs come up at zero, so a freshly placed expander adds the two unlevelled inputs and the stereo pair to the mix and nothing else.
while this module is attached, it and MEGA-TANG each write a line of debug text to standard output on every audio sample. It changes nothing about the sound but fills a log quickly.
the module is monophonic: every jack reads one channel.
